user.title: Connect to Transit App
user.description: Enter your Transit App API key (see https://transitapp.com/apis) and the location to search for nearby stops.

stops.title: Choose stops to track
stops.description: Select the stops you want next-departure sensors for.

filters.title: Save API calls (optional)
filters.description: These are optional and all off by default. Use them to skip polling Transit App when nobody needs the data, to help stay within your API key's call quota.

data.presence_entities: Only poll while one of these is home

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by Transit App.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Transit App API.
error.no_stops_found: No stops were found near that location. Try a larger radius.

abort.already_configured: This combination of API key and stops is already configured.

search_stops.description: Search again to add stops. Stops you already track stay selected even if this search doesn't find them again.
